text: In ages long forgotten, creatures not known to mankind emerged.
zh: 在早已被遗忘的年代，人类未曾知晓的生灵降临于世。

text: They introduced themselves as the Pale Ones.
Upon their descent into the world, they shaped artifacts of power.
zh: 降临此世之后，他们铸造出蕴含力量的神器。

text: The Pale Coins held a power beyond reckoning, flowing to whomever claimed them.
zh: 苍白硬币蕴藏着难以估量的力量，流向每一个将其据为己有的人。

text: Leaving only the artifacts behind, their creators disappeared without a trace.
zh: 它们的创造者只留下这些神器，便消失得无影无踪。

text: The Coins, coveted and fought over, soon became the catalyst for war and devastation.
zh: 硬币引人觊觎、令人相争，很快便成为战争与浩劫的导火索。

text: Deemed too dangerous to exist, their banishment was decreed. Admittedly, against the will of those who obtained their powers.
zh: 它们被视为过于危险之物，注定要被除灭。诚然，这违背了那些已获其力量之人的意愿。

text: One by one, the Pale Coins were destroyed, their legend crumbling until they became nothing more than forgotten echoes.
zh: 苍白硬币被逐一销毁，它们的传说随之瓦解，最终只剩下被遗忘的回响。

text: Tell me, awakened one... Who are you?
